{"effort": "high", "extra": {}, "max_tokens": 8000, "messages": [["user", "## Scenario

Parcel handling across six distribution sites in three regions, Jan-Jun 2024

The network operations group pulled one record per outbound shift from six distribution sites for the first half of 2024, while a new night-shift roster was being trialled.

## Columns

| Column | Kind | Declared as |
|---|---|---|
| `day_of_week` | category | Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun; ordered=ordinal; derived from ship_date; group calendar |
| `handling_cost` | measure | unit USD; additive |
| `is_weekend` | category | No, Yes; ordered=ordinal; derived from ship_date; group calendar |
| `month` | category | 2024-01, 2024-02, 2024-03, 2024-04, 2024-05, 2024-06; ordered=ordinal; derived from ship_date; group calendar |
| `on_time_rate` | measure | unit rate; non-additive |
| `parcels` | measure | unit units; additive |
| `quarter` | category | 2024-Q1, 2024-Q2; ordered=ordinal; derived from ship_date; group calendar |
| `region` | category | North, South, West; group network |
| `shift` | category | Morning, Afternoon, Night; ordered=ordinal; group schedule |
| `ship_date` | time | 2024-01-01 to 2024-06-30, daily; group calendar |
| `site` | category | Aurora, Brookfield, Calder, Dunmore, Eastgate, Fairmont; within region; group network |

## Figures

- `f01`
    p0: bar, grouped by site, SUM(parcels), unit units
    p0 reads site off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: Which site handles the most parcels
- `f02`
    p0: line, grouped by ship_date, SUM(handling_cost), unit USD
    p0 reads ship_date off the axis tick
    drawn to answer: How handling cost moved through the half year
- `f03`
    p0: scatter, grouped by nothing, NONE(parcels, on_time_rate), unit rate, units
    drawn to answer: Whether busier shifts arrive late
- `f04`
    p0-p2 each: grouped_bar, grouped by site, quarter, SUM(parcels), unit units
    p0-p2 each reads site off the axis tick, quarter off the legend
    p0 is titled 'Morning'
    p1 is titled 'Afternoon'
    p2 is titled 'Night'
    the panels are related by: small_multiples
- `f05`
    p0: bar, grouped by site, SUM(parcels), unit units
    p0 reads site off the axis tick
    p1: bar, grouped by shift, SUM(parcels), unit units
    p1 reads shift off the axis tick
    p2: bar, grouped by month, SUM(parcels), unit units
    p2 reads month off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: facet
- `f06`
    p0: bar, grouped by site, SUM(parcels), unit units
    p0 reads site off the axis tick
    p1: grouped_bar, grouped by site, shift, SUM(parcels), unit units
    p1 reads site off the axis tick, shift off the legend
    the panels are related by: drilldown
- `f07`

    p0 reads site off the axis tick

    p0 reads site off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_metric

    p0 reads site off the axis tick
    p0: category_line, grouped by site, SUM(parcels), unit units, labelled '2024-04-01 to 2024-06-30'
    p0 reads site off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_slice
- `f09`
    p0: bar, grouped by site, SUM(parcels), unit units, labelled 'SUM'
    p0 reads site off the axis tick

    p0 reads site off the axis tick
    the panels are related by: overlay_range

    p0: bar, grouped by site, SUM(parcels), unit units

    the panels are related by: facet

    the panels are related by: facet
- `f12`
    p0: bar, grouped by month, SUM(parcels), unit units

    the panels are related by: facet
- `f13`
    p0: bar, grouped by site, SUM(parcels), unit units

    the panels are related by: time_split
- `f14`
    p0: bar, grouped by site, SUM(parcels), unit units
    p0 reads site off the axis tick
    its subtitle is already fixed as '2024-04-01 to 2024-06-30'
    the panels are related by: time_split
- `f15`
    p0: stacked_bar, grouped by month, quarter, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads month off the axis tick, quarter off the legend

- `f20`
    p0: histogram, grouped by nothing, BIN_COUNT(handling_cost), unit USD
- `f21`
    p0: grouped_bar, grouped by quarter, month, COUNT(*)
    p0 reads quarter off the axis tick, month off the legend
- `f22`
    p0: area, grouped by ship_date, quarter, SUM(parcels), unit units
    p0 reads ship_date off the axis tick, quarter off the legend
- `f23`
    p0: pie, grouped by day_of_week, SUM(handling_cost), unit USD
    p0 reads day_of_week off the inline label
- `f24`
    p0: heatmap, grouped by site, is_weekend, MAX(handling_cost), unit USD
    p0 reads site off the axis tick, is_weekend off the axis tick
